biografia.citacao: German Vazquez (a world class maker born in Paracho, Mexico) constructed this instrument after he had examined several instruments in this collection.

fontes.citacao: German Vazquez (a world class maker born in Paracho, Mexico)

factos.valor: Guitarra de Coimbra construída na Califórnia (uma de três), com trastos, cavalete e acabamento a goma-laca de Ronald Fernandez

fontes.citacao: This instrument was one of 3 constructed by German Vazquez, in California; the fretting, bridge and French polishing were done by (your truly) Ronald Fernandez.

factos.valor: Reparou uma fenda no fundo de uma guitarra Santos Beirão da coleção Fernandez

fontes.citacao: It had a crack in the back--which was repaired by German Vazquez and is now just about invisible.
